notes: Exact Cornwall IV manufacturer spec sheet (v03, 2020-01-27). It gives response 34 Hz–20 kHz ±4 dB, sensitivity 102 dB at 2.83 V/1 m with the footnote 'Sensitivity in average listening room', 100 W continuous / 400 W peak handling, and 8-ohm-compatible nominal impedance. The 15-inch K-33-E is the LF driver; the sheet lists three-way HF/MF/LF transducers. The continuous rating is stored and 400 W peak retained as context. No driver-level Thiele/Small values or measured curve are claimed. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/Cornwall-2019-Spec-Sheet-v03.pdf.

Exact Forte IV manufacturer spec sheet (v01, 2018-11). It gives response 38 Hz–20 kHz ±3 dB, sensitivity 99 dB at 2.83 V/1 m with the footnote 'Sensitivity in average listening room', 100 W continuous / 400 W peak handling, and 8-ohm-compatible nominal impedance. The active LF driver is a 12-inch K-281; the separate 15-inch KD-15 is a passive radiator, not counted as an additional driven transducer. Three-way HF/MF/LF system. The continuous rating is stored; 400 W peak is context only. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/Forte-IV-Spec-Sheet-v01-1.pdf.

Exact Heresy IV manufacturer spec sheet (v04, 2020-09-02). It gives 48 Hz–20 kHz ±4 dB, 99 dB at 2.83 V/1 m with sensitivity specified for an average listening room, 100 W continuous / 400 W peak handling, and 8-ohm-compatible nominal impedance. The LF transducer is the 12-inch K-28-E and the model is explicitly three-way. The continuous rating is stored; peak is context only. This is the IV revision and no earlier Heresy revision data is substituted. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/Heresy-IV-Spec-Sheet-v04.pdf.

Exact RP-500M II manufacturer spec sheet (v02, 2022-05-16), not the original RP-500M. It specifies 50 Hz–25 kHz ±3 dB, 92 dB at 2.83 V/1 m, 75 W continuous / 300 W peak handling, 8-ohm-compatible nominal impedance, one 5.25-inch LF driver, and one HF tweeter. The spec-sheet sensitivity footnote reads 'SPL at 1M, half-space anechoic with 2.83V input, in-room sensitivity'; reference is retained as 2.83 V/1 m without claiming the in-room figure is a directivity measurement. Peak handling is context only. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/RP-500M-II_Spec-Sheet_v02_2022-05-18-131859_rlqj.pdf.

Exact RP-8060FA II manufacturer spec sheet (v02, 2022-05-16). Main-channel specification is 35 Hz–25 kHz ±3 dB, 98 dB at 2.83 V/1 m, 8-ohm-compatible impedance, and dual 8-inch LF drivers. The product also includes a separate up-firing height channel with its own 6.5-inch woofer, tweeter, 100 W / 400 W handling specification, and separate frequency-response/sensitivity language; no single system power scalar is stored because the channels have different ratings. Five transducers are listed across the main and height channels. Sensitivity footnote for the main channel: 'SPL at 1M, half-space anechoic with 2.83V input, in-room sensitivity'. The stored woofer size refers only to the main channel's two 8-inch LF units; height-channel driver details remain in this note. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/RP-8060FA-II_Spec-Sheet_v02.pdf.

Exact Klipsch R-41M manufacturer spec sheet (v01; built from 2018). It lists 68 Hz–21 kHz ±3 dB, sensitivity 90 dB at 2.83 V/1 m, 50 W continuous / 200 W peak handling, 8-ohm-compatible nominal impedance, and one 4-inch LF woofer with one tweeter. The 50 W continuous value is stored; the peak rating is context. This is R-41M, not the later R-41PM powered model. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/R-41M_Spec-Sheet_GM_v01.pdf.

Exact Klipsch R-120SW manufacturer spec sheet (built from 2018). It specifies 29–120 Hz ±3 dB and a 12-inch high-excursion spun-copper IMG woofer. The listed 200 W continuous / 400 W peak is the subwoofer's built-in all-digital amplifier output, not passive-speaker power handling; 200 W is stored with role amplifier_output and 400 W remains context. The source shows line/LFE inputs and an internal amplifier; sensitivity and passive input impedance are not published and remain N/A. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/R-120SW_GM_Spec-Sheet_v01.pdf.

Exact Klipsch R-121SW manufacturer spec sheet (v01, 2021-12-06). It publishes a 28–120 Hz frequency range (no tolerance is stated), one 12-inch high-excursion spun-copper TCP woofer, and built-in all-digital amplifier power of 200 W continuous / 400 W peak. The 200 W scalar is explicitly amplifier_output, not speaker power handling; peak output is context. Sensitivity and passive impedance are not published. The response endpoints are unqualified published limits, not a measured response curve. Source: https://assets.klipsch.com/product-specsheets/Reference-R-121SW-Spec-Sheet.pdf.
